summary: BBN's traffic statistics for the ARPANET hosts for April 1973, as tables of packets output per host. Data for two days was missing. It updates RFC 497 and was itself updated by RFC 522.

plainLanguage.summary: This RFC presents host traffic statistics for April 1973. The tables separate packets sent between nodes from packets sent within a node and include summary totals.

sections.title: The April Traffic Report
sections.content:
A. McKenzie of BBN-NET provides host traffic statistics for April 1973. The report is a Host Throughput Summary of packets output and states that data is missing for April 1 and 7.

It is a collection of measured traffic figures, not a protocol specification.
sections.plainLanguage: This is the April edition of the host traffic report. It says that data for two days is missing.

sections.title: Host and Site Measurements
sections.content:
The table groups entries by site and host number. For each host it gives internode packet output, intranode packet output and a total. Where a site has multiple hosts, the report includes site figures and an average daily internode count.

The report says BELV, ABER and LBL had no traffic. It gives 28 days for the listed site averages.
sections.plainLanguage: The table separates each host's traffic to other nodes from traffic inside its node. It also gives totals and averages for each site.

sections.title: Reported Network Totals
sections.content:
The report's summary gives 66843250 internode packets and 18403070 intranode packets. It lists daily averages of 2387259 internode packets and 657253 intranode packets.

It also reports an average per node-day of 66313 internode and 18257 intranode packets, and an internode packets-to-messages ratio of 1.06.
sections.plainLanguage: The summary provides network-wide packet totals and daily averages. It also lists the reported ratio of internode packets to messages.
